# NexaHubTech

> NexaHubTech is a Nigeria-based software development company. We design, build and maintain production software for businesses and founders — scoped carefully, built properly, and supported long after launch.

Motto: "Learn to build. Build for real." Based at Phase 2, F01 Building Materials Market, Kubwa, FCT-Abuja, Nigeria (CAC RC 9545130). Its training division, NexaHubTech Academy, runs as a separate business with its own pages. Every Academy course is taught live and starts whenever the student is ready, online or in person (no more than 6 per in-person class, priced above a place online). PC Basics and CBT training are taught in person only. Fees can be paid in instalments. Prices are in Nigerian naira (NGN). Contact: nexahubt@gmail.com, +234 913 451 3173, WhatsApp https://wa.me/2349134513173.

Each link below is the markdown version of a page on https://nexahubtech.company; drop the `.md` suffix for the HTML page.

## Start here

- [Home](https://nexahubtech.company/home.md): NexaHubTech designs, builds and maintains production software for businesses and founders — scoped carefully, built properly, and supported long after launch. Based in Abuja, Nigeria.

## NexaHubTech Academy — the training division

NexaHubTech Academy is the training division of NexaHubTech. It teaches software development, data, office productivity and video in live, instructor-led courses — online or in person, starting any day.

- [NexaHubTech Academy](https://nexahubtech.company/academy.md): NexaHubTech Academy, the training division of NexaHubTech, offers live, instructor-led courses in software development, data, office productivity and video. Learn online or in person, start any day, and pay in instalments.
- [Courses](https://nexahubtech.company/courses.md): Every NexaHubTech Academy course, from first steps on a computer to React, data analysis and video — taught live, online or in person, with flexible payment plans. Start any day.
- [Fees](https://nexahubtech.company/fees.md): Every NexaHubTech Academy fee on one page: each course online and in person, paid in full or in instalments, plus CBT practice and rates for organisations.
- [Timetable](https://nexahubtech.company/timetable.md): When NexaHubTech Academy classes run each week, online and in person. There are no fixed intakes: start any day and join the session that suits you.
- [WAEC & JAMB CBT Training](https://nexahubtech.company/cbt.md): Get comfortable with the computer-based exam before the day. CBT practice for JAMB and WAEC candidates at NexaHubTech Academy, Phase 2, F01 Building Materials Market, Kubwa: keyboard shortcuts, pacing, past questions and timed mock exams.
- [For Business](https://nexahubtech.company/for-business.md): Train your staff, your students or your team with NexaHubTech Academy: Microsoft Office taught at your office, CBT exam practice for schools, and any course for a group — online, in person or at your office.
- [Learning Centre](https://nexahubtech.company/centre.md): Visit the NexaHubTech Academy learning centre at Phase 2, F01 Building Materials Market, Kubwa, FCT-Abuja: small classes of no more than 6, machines provided, open Monday – Saturday, 8:00 AM – 6:00 PM. You are welcome to visit before you enrol.
- [How We Teach](https://nexahubtech.company/teaching.md): The pedagogy behind every NexaHubTech Academy course: the mental model before the syntax, one idea at a time, and a session built in three parts.
- [Enrol](https://nexahubtech.company/enrol.md): Apply for a place at NexaHubTech Academy — taught live, online or in person, and started whenever you are ready. Tell us about you, pick your course and how you want to learn, and we'll agree your start date and session times.

## Courses

- [Computer Essentials](https://nexahubtech.company/courses/computer-essentials.md): Digital Literacy. Live online ₦37,500 (or 2 × ₦20,000) · In person ₦45,000 (or 2 × ₦25,000). 3 Weeks. Three weeks from never having used a computer to saving, finding and printing your own work — with somebody beside you the whole way.
- [PC Basics](https://nexahubtech.company/courses/pc-basics.md): Digital Literacy. In person ₦75,000 (or 2 × ₦40,000). 6 Weeks. Start at the very beginning — the computer itself, and the confidence to use one without being afraid of breaking it.
- [Office Essentials](https://nexahubtech.company/courses/office-essentials.md): Word & Excel. Live online ₦45,000 (or 2 × ₦25,000) · In person ₦55,000 (or 2 × ₦30,000). 4 Weeks. The two programs most office work actually happens in — Word and Excel — in four weeks, taught properly.
- [Microsoft Office](https://nexahubtech.company/courses/microsoft-office.md): Word, Excel, PowerPoint & Access. Live online ₦80,000 (or 2 × ₦42,500) · In person ₦95,000 (or 2 × ₦52,500). 8 Weeks. The four programs an office actually runs on, taught to the standard the work deserves.
- [Python Programming](https://nexahubtech.company/courses/python-programming.md): Live online ₦95,000 (or 2 × ₦52,500) · In person ₦115,000 (or 2 × ₦62,500). 6 Weeks. Learn programming from scratch with Python — the language that powers everything from scripts to AI.
- [JavaScript Programming](https://nexahubtech.company/courses/javascript-programming.md): Browser & Node.js. Live online ₦95,000 (or 2 × ₦52,500) · In person ₦115,000 (or 2 × ₦62,500). 8 Weeks. Learn JavaScript as a language — the same core that runs in a browser and on a server.
- [Frontend Development](https://nexahubtech.company/courses/frontend-development.md): Live online ₦120,000 (or 2 × ₦65,000) · In person ₦145,000 (or 2 × ₦77,500). 10 Weeks. Learn the web from first principles — HTML, CSS, and JavaScript done properly.
- [Backend Development](https://nexahubtech.company/courses/backend-development.md): Live online ₦110,000 (or 2 × ₦60,000) · In person ₦135,000 (or 2 × ₦72,500). 8 Weeks. Build the engine behind applications — APIs, databases, and server-side logic.
- [Web Development](https://nexahubtech.company/courses/web-development-fullstack.md): Fullstack. Live online ₦200,000 (or 3 × ₦75,000) · In person ₦240,000 (or 3 × ₦87,500). 18 Weeks. Learn frontend and backend in one complete path — from first principles to full applications.
- [React](https://nexahubtech.company/courses/react-development.md): Intermediate to Advanced. Live online ₦130,000 (or 2 × ₦70,000) · In person ₦160,000 (or 2 × ₦87,500). 8 Weeks. Go beyond the basics — build React applications that stay understandable as they grow.
- [Next.js](https://nexahubtech.company/courses/nextjs-fullstack.md): Fullstack React. Live online ₦160,000 (or 2 × ₦87,500) · In person ₦195,000 (or 2 × ₦105,000). 10 Weeks. Build fullstack applications on the React metaframework — routing, rendering, and data in one stack.
- [Mobile Development](https://nexahubtech.company/courses/mobile-development.md): Live online ₦190,000 (or 2 × ₦102,500) · In person ₦230,000 (or 2 × ₦125,000). 12 Weeks. Build real mobile applications — from concept to the app store.
- [Data Analysis](https://nexahubtech.company/courses/data-analysis.md): Live online ₦130,000 (or 2 × ₦70,000) · In person ₦160,000 (or 2 × ₦87,500). 10 Weeks. Turn raw data into clear insights — with Python, SQL, and real analytical thinking.
- [Mobile Videography](https://nexahubtech.company/courses/mobile-videography.md): Phone video & editing. Live online ₦50,000 (or 2 × ₦27,500) · In person ₦60,000 (or 2 × ₦32,500). 4 Weeks. Shoot, light, record and edit video worth watching — on the phone you already own.
- [Videography & Video Editing](https://nexahubtech.company/courses/videography-video-editing.md): Live online ₦100,000 (or 2 × ₦55,000) · In person ₦120,000 (or 2 × ₦65,000). 8 Weeks. Capture and craft video content that communicates — from shooting to final cut.
- [Cybersecurity](https://nexahubtech.company/courses/cybersecurity.md): Live online ₦230,000 (or 3 × ₦82,500) · In person ₦280,000 (or 3 × ₦100,000). 16 Weeks. Understand how systems are attacked — and how to defend them.
